definitions.gloss: purse snatching; bag snatching; snatch theft
definitions.explanation: The crime of grabbing someone's bag or belongings and running away, typically committed on the street. Also refers to the person who commits this crime.

examples.japanese: ひったくりに{遭|あ}った。
examples.english: I was the victim of a purse snatching.

examples.japanese: バイクに{乗|の}ったひったくりに{鞄|かばん}を{奪|うば}われた。
examples.english: A snatch thief on a motorcycle grabbed my bag.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}ではひったくりが{多発|たはつ}しているので、{鞄|かばん}は{車道|しゃどう}と{反対側|はんたいがわ}に{持|も}つようにしてください。
examples.english: Snatch thefts are frequent in this area, so please carry your bag on the side away from the road.

notes:
USAGE:
Can refer to both the crime itself and the person committing it. Derived from the verb ひったくる (to snatch away). A common street crime in urban areas, often committed by someone on a bicycle or motorcycle targeting pedestrians.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ひったくりに{遭|あ}う (to be a victim of snatching)
- ひったくり{被害|ひがい} (snatch theft damage/victimization)
- ひったくり{犯|はん} (snatch thief — refers specifically to the criminal)
- ひったくり{防止|ぼうし} (snatch theft prevention)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スリ: pickpocketing — stealthily taking items from pockets or bags without the victim noticing
- {置|お}き{引|び}き: theft of unattended belongings — taking bags or items left momentarily
